full_judgment: 20. Under the provision of section 152 of the Code of Civil Procedure clerical or arithmetical mistake in the judgment, decree or order or errors arising therefrom may at any time be corrected by the Court either of its own motion or on the application of a party. [reference: Golam Nobi vs Mohammadul Haque Chowdhury being dead his heirs: Mohammad Ali and others 1982 BCR (AD) 166].
